title: Repeat Call-Center Bookings and the Crestline Companion Phone Booking Fee
content:
The phone booking fee on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product is raised by the companion bookings made through the reservations call center on the certificate or pass with an entry date in the last 12 months, counted back from the handling date, the booking being charged included.

| Call-center companion bookings on the certificate or pass in the last 12 months, this one included | Raise of the phone booking fee |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 40 percent |
| exactly 2 | 20 percent |
| a single one | none |

- Bookings made online are not counted.
- A call-center booking entered more than 12 months before the handling date is not counted.

**Hypothetical cases.** A pass whose only call-center booking in the last 12 months is the one being charged has no raise. With one earlier call-center booking in that period the raise is 20 percent; with two or more earlier ones it is 40 percent.
